figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY difference_cents DESC

figures.title: 订单结算与收入核对：净销售对比 成功收款 − 退款

stages.label: ① 处理前：按订单汇集成功收款与退款（分）
stages.note: 没有退款的订单在退款表里没有行，对比时按 0 处理。

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT order_id, paid FROM a WHERE order_id IN (2,3,27277) ORDER BY order_id
tables.name: 成功收款（截至 2025-12-31）

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT order_id, refunded FROM b WHERE order_id IN (2,3,27277) ORDER BY order_id
tables.name: 实际退款（截至 2025-12-31）

stages.label: ② 现金净额 = 成功收款 − 退款，和订单净销售对比
stages.via: 差额 = 现金净额 − 净销售；差额为 0 说明这张订单对得上

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_id IN (2,3,27277) ORDER BY o.order_id

stages.label: ③ 处理后：只列出差额非零的订单
stages.via: WHERE 现金净额 <> 净销售

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY difference_cents DESC
